  "content": "from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, render_template_string, send_from_directory
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from flask_migrate import Migrate
import json
from datetime import datetime

bp = Blueprint('api', __name__)

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///coffee_shop.db'
app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False
db = SQLAlchemy(app)
migrate = Migrate(app, db)

coffee_shop_schema = 'coffee_shop'

class CoffeeShop(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    address = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    phone = db.Column(db.String(15), nullable=False)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False)
    menu = db.Column(db.JSON, nullable=True)
    contact_info = db.Column(db.JSON, nullable=True)

def init_app(app):
    db.create_all()

@bp.route('/coffeeshops', methods=['GET', 'POST'])
def coffeeshops():
    if request.method == 'GET':
        coffeeshops = CoffeeShop.query.all()
        return jsonify([{'id': coffee_shop.id, 'name': coffee_shop.name, 'address': coffee_shop.address, 'phone': coffee_shop.phone, 'email': coffee_shop.email, 'menu': coffee_shop.menu, 'contact_info': coffee_shop.contact_info} for coffee_shop in coffeeshops]), 200
    elif request.method == 'POST':
        data = request.get_json()
        new_coffee_shop = CoffeeShop(name=data['name'], address=data['address'], phone=data['phone'], email=data['email'], menu=data['menu'], contact_info=data['contact_info'])
        db.session.add(new_coffee_shop)
        db.session.commit()
        return jsonify({'id': new_coffee_shop.id, 'name': new_coffee_shop.name, 'address': new_coffee_shop.address, 'phone': new_coffee_shop.phone, 'email': new_coffee_shop.email, 'menu': new_coffee_shop.menu, 'contact_info': new_coffee_shop.contact_info}), 201

@bp.route('/coffeeshops/<int:item_id>', methods=['GET', 'PUT', 'DELETE'])
def coffee_shop(item_id):
    coffee_shop = CoffeeShop.query.get_or_404(item_id)
    if request.method == 'GET':
        return jsonify({'id': coffee_shop.id, 'name': coffee_shop.name, 'address': coffee_shop.address, 'phone': coffee_shop.phone, 'email': coffee_shop.email, 'menu': coffee_shop.menu, 'contact_info': coffee_shop.contact_info}), 200
    elif request.method == 'PUT':
        data = request.get_json()
        coffee_shop.name = data['name'] if 'name' in data else coffee_shop.name
        coffee_shop.address = data['address'] if 'address' in data else coffee_shop.address
        coffee_shop.phone = data['phone'] if 'phone' in data else coffee_shop.phone
        coffee_shop.email = data['email'] if 'email' in data else coffee_shop.email
        coffee_shop.menu = data['menu'] if 'menu' in data else coffee_shop.menu
        coffee_shop.contact_info = data['contact_info'] if 'contact_info' in data else coffee_shop.contact_info
        db.session.commit()
        return jsonify(coffee_shop.to_dict()), 200
    elif request.method == 'DELETE':
        db.session.delete(coffee_shop)
        db.session.commit()
        return jsonify({'message': 'Coffee shop deleted'}), 204
